boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain The University of Tampa
boards.description: Ten all-ages food and beverage destinations with published late availability in Tampa, including two on West Kennedy Boulevard by campus.

cards.title: Dunkin' on West Kennedy
cards.subtitle: 1622 W Kennedy Blvd, Tampa
cards.notes: Use the West Kennedy location when you need a nearby all-hours food-and-coffee stop; confirm offerings in the app before heading over.
cards.short_summary: An official Dunkin' locator lists this West Kennedy location as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin' lists its 1622 W Kennedy Blvd Tampa location as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists 1622 W Kennedy Blvd as open 24 hours; availability may vary for individual menu items.

cards.title: Wendy's on West Kennedy
cards.subtitle: 1615 W Kennedy Blvd, Tampa
cards.notes: Check the day-specific closing time before leaving campus, then use the restaurant or drive-thru option stated on Wendy's location page.
cards.short_summary: A West Kennedy fast-food location with published service through 2 or 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published restaurant and drive-thru hours: until 2 a.m. Mon–Wed and Sun; until 3 a.m. Thu–Sat. Holiday hours may vary.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell / KFC — 1605 W Kennedy Boulevard
cards.title: Taco Bell / KFC on West Kennedy
cards.subtitle: 1605 W Kennedy Blvd, Tampa
cards.notes: Use this named Kennedy Boulevard location for a late food stop; verify whether you want dine-in or drive-thru before you go.
cards.short_summary: The official location page publishes midnight-to-1 a.m. late service windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 1605 W Kennedy Blvd location open until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 1 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell / KFC — 1605 W. Kennedy Boulevard
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours end at midnight Sun–Wed and 1 a.m. Thu–Sat; the page also lists dine-in hours.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on West Platt
cards.subtitle: 614 W Platt St, Tampa
cards.notes: Plan a carryout or delivery order from the Platt Street restaurant and check the official page for the current service option you need.
cards.short_summary: This nearby Pizza Hut publishes late carryout and delivery hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists its 614 W Platt St restaurant open until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 614 W Platt St, Tampa
cards.access_notes: Published restaurant hours: until 1 a.m. Sun–Thu and 2 a.m. Fri–Sat; the page notes delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Tampa Pizza Company Downtown
cards.subtitle: 777 N Ashley Dr, Suite C, Tampa
cards.notes: Use the downtown location's official hours page for a Friday or Saturday pizza run, and place an order through the business directly.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza restaurant with published service until 1:30 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Tampa Pizza Company lists its Downtown Tampa location open until 1:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list Sunday–Thursday until 10:30 p.m. and Friday–Saturday until 1:30 a.m.

cards.title: Pizza Kitchen on North Florida
cards.subtitle: 1000 N Florida Ave, Tampa
cards.notes: Check the day before leaving: Friday and Saturday have the latest listed service, while weekday and Sunday closing times are earlier.
cards.short_summary: Pizza Kitchen's official page lists 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Kitchen lists Friday–Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–3 a.m. at 1000 N Florida Ave.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 11 p.m. Mon–Thu, 3 a.m. Fri–Sat, and 10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Monster Pizza in Ybor City
cards.subtitle: 1616 E 7th Ave, Tampa
cards.notes: For a later citywide option, use the official site to confirm the open day, then navigate to the named Seventh Avenue location.
cards.short_summary: A Ybor City pizza shop with published service until 3:30 a.m. on its open days.
cards.evidence_claim: Monster Pizza lists Sunday hours until 3:30 a.m. and Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday hours until 3:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Sunday noon–3:30 a.m.; Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 5 p.m.–3:30 a.m.; closed Monday and Wednesday.

cards.title: ABC Pizza House
cards.subtitle: 1242 W Hillsborough Ave, Tampa
cards.notes: Use the business's location page to check the late pickup window and select a day; Saturday has the latest published closing time.
cards.short_summary: ABC Pizza House publishes pickup service until 2 or 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: ABC Pizza House lists pickup hours until 2 a.m. Monday–Friday and Sunday, and until 3 a.m. Saturday.
cards.source_title: ABC Pizza House Directions & Business Hours
cards.access_notes: Published pickup hours: 3 p.m.–2 a.m. Mon–Fri, 3 p.m.–3 a.m. Sat, and 4 p.m.–2 a.m. Sun.

cards.title: Five Star Pizza Tampa
cards.subtitle: 10926 N 56th St, Temple Terrace
cards.notes: Treat this as a wider-Tampa delivery or pickup option; use the official ordering page and allow travel time from The University of Tampa.
cards.short_summary: A nearby-area pizza option publishing daily service through 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Star Pizza lists its Tampa location at 10926 N 56th St open daily from 11 a.m. to 3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 11 a.m.–3 a.m.; this Temple Terrace address is a longer trip from campus.

cards.title: Kay's Chicken Kitchen on Bearss
cards.subtitle: 2808 E Bearss Ave, Tampa
cards.notes: Use the Bearss Avenue location—not the satellite location—when planning a late pickup or dine-in visit, and check the stated closed day.
cards.short_summary: The Bearss Avenue location has published late-night hours, including 4 a.m. weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Kay's Chicken Kitchen lists its Bearss Avenue location open until 2 a.m. Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday, and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published Bearss Ave hours: until 2 a.m. Tue–Thu and Sun; until 4 a.m. Fri–Sat; closed Monday. This is a longer trip from campus.

warnings: Hours are business-published and may change; confirm on the linked official page before traveling.
